resolution: Studio paint atlas showed thin off-colour seam lines at every face boundary plus a neighbour slot's paint bleeding onto a face corner (a green sliver that refused black). Root cause was bilinear sampling: framework/gpu/3d.zig g_diffuse_sampler was .linear, so a face's UV-edge texels averaged with the adjacent gutter / neighbour slot in the packed atlas — the soft-edged green and the white seams. The code comment said it should be nearest; the value had drifted. Flipped g_diffuse_sampler to nearest (mag+min) and the bind-group layout sampler entry to .non_filtering to match. Scene-composite sampler left linear. Global to all 3D diffuse textures (matches the PSX aesthetic); can be made per-texture later. Compiles+links clean via SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 rjit ship hmsc-int.
